english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for things sharing the same characteristics or remaining consistent.

examples.english: The high uniformity of the team’s uniform colours makes everyone look neat.
examples.traditional: 呢隊制服嘅顏色一致性好高，成隊人睇落好整齊。
